summary: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA's October best-buy list, published 2026-10-05 — nine names, all DCF-based BUYs with his own fair-value estimates: AMZN — BUY (FV $292 vs $251, ~16% upside), AWS re-accelerating with +37% YoY growth; bought for his own portfolio. META — BUY (implied FV ~$838 vs $728, ~15% upside), AI capex starting to pay off; added to his portfolio. NFLX — BUY (FV garbled in captions, vs $67 near the 52-week low), the most undervalued name in his view and his largest portfolio allocation. NVDA — BUY (FV $335), sold-out demand and 1–2 steps ahead of rivals; his second-largest holding. UBER — BUY (FV $113 vs $68), driverless fears overblown with autonomy under 1% of rides; bought and adding more. PINS — BUY (FV $35 vs $19), North America user growth; he owns it. V — BUY (implied FV ~$433+ vs $361, 20%+ upside), a 4B+ cards merchant moat; owns, adding more. ADBE — BUY (FV $339 vs $238), enterprise switching costs against AI competition; owns it. MCD — BUY (FV $283 vs $232), AI/automation upside; the only name he doesn't own yet, interested in adding. No stance flips — AMZN, META, NVDA, V, MCD and PINS were already BUYs on record, while NFLX, UBER and ADBE are first-time calls. He notes Micron was up 125% before he removed it from his top list, and that a full portfolio reveal video is members-only.
